purpose: Thematic equities the agentic fund manager should monitor and consider — not auto-buy. Core allowlist remains preferred for default rebalances.

entries.notes: Re-run verbose 2026-07-23: strong AI-power thesis + Oracle/Brookfield frameworks; critic blocks size-in (valuation, beta, ~$8 NAV, into 7/28 print). Revisit post-print or capital/price change. Not core.
